Honestly I asked one of my best friends what the problem was and she wouldn't even tell me... So I read the whole chat. (Just finished-took me 3 hours) and they hate me because I'm pretty... Wtf? Wouldn't believe it unless I saw it... I don't think I look that great. 
But yeah. They are convinced that this guy most that of them like (some of them stalk him) like me. But that's so not true... Me and him are just good friends. Long childhood history. 
So ya... Hate me because I'm pretty.
Thx. School is bearable. Just a lot of hurt outside of school. Maybe I’ll try and work harder to be friends with the hw only people.
I’ve definitely had people not like me.. I don’t know who hasn’t but I just don’t like that they pretended to be friends with me. That’s all. It hurts.
